Connect your database to your bot

This page is on and nowhere else. Check your browser's address bar now: if it shows any other address, close this page. Your database's admin connection string goes from this page to Basalt Vault's connect service for this one setup, and is never stored.

Paste the setup code

Paste the code or the whole message your bot sent. The code starts with basalt-setup.1.

      Setup fingerprint:

      Check that your bot shows the same fingerprint. If it does not, stop: this code is not the one your bot made.

      Your passkey

      Your fingerprint or face never leaves this device; Basalt only receives a signature.

      Your database's admin connection string

      Paste the connection string with the admin password. It is sent to the connect service when you press Check, kept only in this page's memory until the setup runs, and then forgotten. Never paste it into the chat with your bot.

      Before you approve

        Result

          Your passkey's check code:

          Your bot names the same code when it picks up the setup. A different code, or a passkey you did not create, means something is wrong: remove it.

          Now tell your bot "done"

          Your bot notices the finished setup when it next checks its status. Say "done" in the chat so it checks now.
